title: More CFD sleeves: CME crypto-expiry fade, crypto-weekend -> Monday equity index, pre-FOMC drift on BTC/ETH CFDs

costs: crypto CFDs: BTC/ETH 5 bp per side, swap 3.3 bp per rollover held (22:00 UTC); index CFDs US100/US500: 1 bp per side, positions closed before the daily rollover (no swap)

tests.E1 CME expiry fade (PRIMARY): last Friday of each month (CME BTC/ETH futures final settlement = CF Benchmarks rate 15:00-16:00 London): at 16:00 London take -sign(BTC/ETH return 15:00->16:00 London) per coin, exit at 18:00 London; BTC and ETH equal weight
tests.E2 crypto weekend -> Monday index (PRIMA: signal = sign of BTC return Friday 20:00 UTC -> Sunday 21:00 UTC (Binance hourly closes); trade US100 and US500 CFDs (equal weight) from the open of the first hourly bar after Sunday 21:00 UTC to the open of the Monday 20:00 UTC bar, long if the signal is positive, short if negative

tests.E3 variant: exit 16:00 New York (after the press conference)
